title: Ravelry Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often ravelry metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on ravelry metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your ravelry metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
